purpose: Test whether ubatch 512 improves the qualified exact-cache c96 endpoint while preserving all 96 same-shape outputs. A prior cache-off c64 diagnostic saw a nonpromoted +1.76% signal at ubatch 512; this experiment does not transfer that rate and measures the distinct c96 cached shape directly.
hardware: Two local Intel Arc Pro B70 cards; no remote host.
fixed_configuration: Qwen3.8-27B Q4_K_M, llama.cpp SYCL TP2 tensor 1,1, MTP0, exact F16 cache for ffn_down and ffn_gate, 96 pinned slots, requested context 32768 and effective pool 49152 (96x512), batch 2048, ubatch 512, FUSE_EXT=31, temperature 0, prompt cache off, 128 generated token IDs/request, admission target 96 with 1000 ms ceiling.
oracle: Committed c96 same-shape control-batch oracle SHA-256 f0d26606c46b72d8701ca43f113625d5630fa16b17cd8e9db4ea563cbf591ff1. This is aggregate-capacity identity evidence, not sequential determinism.
advance_rule: Attempt 1 must match the frozen c96 batch oracle 96/96, pass completeness/cache/liveness/health gates and exceed 192.35094949480367 tok/s. Only then repeat. Promotion requires both attempts 96/96 and their center above 192.34195380893704 tok/s.
failure_policy: Any mismatch, OOM/health failure or first rate at or below 192.35094949480367 closes r18. No failed-arm or single-run rate is promoted and no rate transfers to another shape.
